prompt: How many columns will this GridLayout have?
code:
JPanel panel = new JPanel(new GridLayout(0, 3));
for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) panel.add(new JButton(String.valueOf(i)));
explanation: GridLayout(0, 3) means: any number of rows, exactly 3 columns. Adding 9 buttons creates 3 rows of 3. The 0 for rows means rows are added automatically.
